story.fullStory:
Cat Stevens's "The Hurt" reached #31 on the Billboard Hot 100. Foreigner is the seventh studio album released by British-Emirati singer-songwriter Cat Stevens in July 1973.

The song peaked at #31 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 10 weeks on the chart.

The Hurt was released in 1973.

Artist: Cat Stevens · Title: The Hurt · Album: Cat Stevens - Majikat (Earth Tour 1976) · Year: 2008 · Genre: Rock · Path: /Users/bobhopp/DJ MEDIA/VIDEO/1970's/Cat Stevens - The Hurt.mp4
Foreigner is the seventh studio album released by British-Emirati singer-songwriter Cat Stevens in July 1973.

In addition to the minor hit "The Hurt", which received a moderate amount of airplay, Foreigner also included such songs as "100 I Dream" and the 18-minute-long "Foreigner Suite", which took up the entirety of side one.
It is the first album written and produced solely by Stevens.
